title: Prove the sharp five-summary source floor (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp pointwise source-count floor determined by five inventory summaries in the separated nested-flow model. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas.

```text
old floor:       S(c) >= W^(g+1)
new exact floor: W^(g+1) + (Q-W) * sum of explicit binomial-tail deficits
attainer:        productive ranks {L:W-t,M:t}, paid ranks {1:Q}
```

Here L and M are the exact productive minimum and maximum, t is the maximum-rank multiplicity, W is the productive count, Q>=W is the paid count, and every positive paid rank is below L. The proof preserves token identities while decreasing all other productive ranks to L and every paid rank to 1. It gives the exact minimum over inventories with those summaries and the sharp floor throughout each height slab.

For the unchanged historical #4470 power-1024 rule, the first strict uniform correction is

```text
S(c) >= W^3 + (Q0-W)t^2 > W^3,   L^2 <= c < L^3,
L=21^1024, W=10928^1024, Q0=64620^1024, t=224^1024.
```

A stated binomial-tail correction applies at every height g>=2. This partially answers the quantified top-slab deficit question in aliromman's [#5318](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5318). Its telescope and historical invoice are cited premises, without replaying predecessor scientific executables. Credit JoyboyBrian #5067, zxv #4436, 1337isnot1337/zxv #4470, jacobalansussman, unpaidmoon #5273 and the retained compiler lineage. The binomial identity is classical. Nick Petalas #5109 is related upper-bound background and is not a proof step.

Only seven files in `research/binomial-source-floor/` are added. The actual historical inventory receives a lower bound; it is not claimed to attain the relaxed summary minimum. No accumulated K/N coefficient, compiler-width reduction, physical saving, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19595351).

## Evidence

Before, the source floor did not quantify these deficits. After, the pointwise binomial expression is proved sharp and the power-1024 correction is explicit.

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only:

- The direct root/nonroot slot enumerator passes 2,250 inventory/cap cases, including 459 strict comparisons. A separate product-histogram implementation passes 1,640 attaining cases through height six.
- Eight semantic checks and eight domain rejections cover Q=W, the Q<W reversal, slab entry, strict cutoff equality and first activation. The new power-1024 correction has 32,353 bits, with a generated exact hash in the verifier output.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass with identical hash-bound receipts. The exact registered arguments took 0.067 and 0.066 seconds locally; the registered package runner passed both commands.
- Committed bytes, executable modes and declared source history pass at `7e07363cde42f46681cf9e32db54312277a66108`, covering all seven package files and both inputs. Official export integrity/input coverage passes. Normal and optimized replay also pass from a read-only Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/binomial-source-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/binomial-source-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/binomial-source-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/binomial-source-floor --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Replace the absolute interpreter path with a local CPython 3.12 executable on another machine. Expected markers are `PASS_BINOMIAL_SOURCE_FLOOR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim rests on the written proof and the credited all-height telescope. The executable reference is bounded to L<=16, M<=32, W<=Q<=8 and height at most six; the fixed power-1024 arithmetic is separate. No enormous production histogram or actual large-height compiler is enumerated. The correction is small and does not establish an improved accumulated coefficient.

This is a count result for a historical compiler, not a finite certificate of the current selected supplier. Native all-column semantics, physical stock, routing, ownership, precision/tape, uniform caller admission and analytic recovery remain unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No complete multiplication theorem follows.

## Open next questions

- Use more of the productive histogram to obtain a stronger finite-height deficit estimate and determine whether it improves the accumulated K/N coefficient. Start with one additional rank class under the same historical completion rule.
- Bind the separated-source model to a current physical caller with complete owned-lifetime, stock and routing costs. The mathematical count supplies no physical implementation.

## Related open work

- #7345 generates exact chronological rank libraries; this result bounds source counts over inventory summaries instead of constructing those libraries.
- #7346 indexes Pascal occurrences and owners; this result keeps token multiplicity but supplies no addressing implementation.
- #7347 ranks and unranks replicated source rows; this result is a sharp count bound and does not implement row access.
- #7423 locates expanded leaves and preserves source/owned identities; those operational obligations are outside this count theorem.
- #7424 extends libraries to independent ambient caps and proves an explicit-output obstruction; this result concerns the older nested source-count floor.
- #7464 sharpens chronological plateau visit exponents; this result improves a distinct source-count quantity and uses none of its construction or proof.
- #7178 proves multiplicative-shell growth for an adaptive width estimate; this result concerns the fixed default-height separated source census, not shell growth.

- [#7535](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7535) proves an any-power fixed-cap tensor-splitting feasibility criterion; it concerns paid moments rather than this separated source-count floor, and no common numerical quantity is compared.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this package. At unchanged head `7e07363cde42f46681cf9e32db54312277a66108`, [run 43467919361](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467919361) failed in [plan job 132031902557](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467919361/job/132031902557), step `Onboarding helper tests`. The downloaded log reports exactly one failing test out of 760, with 24 skipped:

`test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`

The AssertionError states that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification document. On the unchanged canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` names that command, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. The PR changes neither file nor the failing test. The [package replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467919361/job/132034763908) was skipped because plan failed.

I also downloaded and read the failed logs for rohanarun's [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314/job/130140894651) and dillona's [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790/job/130134720799). Each reports the identical failing test, missing-command assertion, 760 tests, one failure and 24 skips. Their replay jobs were also skipped. These independently observed logs establish the shared repository-level navigation failure; they do not certify this package.

All scientific evidence claimed above remains local. No fix, retrigger commit or CI rerun was made. The published head is unchanged.

## Merge danger

Door: reversible. Blast radius: package. Shared code, predecessor evidence and the selected record are unchanged.
